resources.string: This reviewed APK is inert until trusted production enrollment is provisioned.
There is no calendar shutdown date. Stop is explicit, by revocation, or by an invalid safety gate.
Signed assignments and the fixed official TeleBirr route only. No editable URL or API key.
No database, KemerBet, settlement, or financial-action authority.

On the authenticated Owner page, create one short-lived phone pairing package. Paste only that package here. It is one-use and is not an API key, receipt reference, receiver name, or account credential.
Continue only if this package was just created in the authenticated FetanAgent Owner page. The device private key will remain non-exportable in Android Keystore.

Paste the fresh twelve-hour routine package from the authenticated Owner page. The phone signs a short-lived proof locally; it does not connect to the provider or enroll itself. Copy the proof directly back to the same Owner tab promptly. Do not send either value through chat, email, or screenshots.
The routine package is invalid or damaged. Create a fresh package on the Owner page.
Only continue if this fresh package came directly from the authenticated FetanAgent Owner page. Signing grants no assignment polling or money authority.
Copy signed proof to Owner page
The short-lived signed proof was copied. Paste it into the routine proof field on the authenticated Owner page before it expires. The phone is not enrolled until Owner confirms it.
Proof expires at %1$s. The phone is not enrolled until the Owner page accepts it.
The routine proof could not be signed. Check the phone clock and create a fresh Owner package. No enrollment occurred.
Visible health and stop control for the dedicated verifier phone
Dedicated operator phone continuously polls short-lived signed TeleBirr evidence assignments, uploads evidence only, and exposes a persistent health and stop notification.
